{{Quote|''[Boles Roor]'' is scheduled for next week's Dasoor Challenge, which is to be held the day of the vote, weather permitting.|[[HoloNet News/Legends|HoloNet News]] report|<ref name="HNN">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|55|regional/1359_1.html|Campaigning Reports from the Mid Rim}}</ref>}}
'''Dasoor''' was a [[Planet/Legends|world]] located in the [[Dasoor system/Legends|Dasoor system]] of the [[Agarix sector/Legends|Agarix sector]], a part of the [[Western Reaches/Legends|Western Reaches]] portion of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]. A [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] known as the [[Agarix Trade Route]] connected it to the [[Umthyg system/Legends|Umthyg system]] of the nearby [[Juvex sector/Legends|Juvex sector]].<ref name="TEA" />

Dasoor was a popular location for various circuits of the [[Podracing/Legends|Podracing]] sport,<ref name="TEA" /> including the [[Dasoor Challenge/Legends|Dasoor Challenge]], one of the best-known such events in the Mid Rim.<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|I|172|Dasoor Challenge}}</ref> One instance of that race was scheduled, weather permitting, for the [[Great ReSynchronization|date]] [[22 BBY/Legends|13:5:16]].<ref name="HNN" /> By [[43 ABY]],<ref name="43 ABY">The section of ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' describing Dasoor ends with a mention of [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke]] and [[Ben Skywalker]]'s journey across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], the beginning of which is depicted in ''[[Fate of the Jedi: Outcast]]''. The events of that novel are dated to [[43 ABY]] by ''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''.</ref> Dasoor's fame had given way to it becoming largely lawless and ruled by criminal gangs that were financed by parties in the Juvex [[Sector/Legends|sector]].<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
Dasoor's name was introduced as part of a mention of the Dasoor Challenge in [[HoloNet News Vol. 531 55|''HoloNet News Vol. 531'' #55]], a representation of an [[in-universe]] issue of the HoloNet News<ref name="HNN" /> written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]] and [[Paul Ens]]<ref name="Credits">{{HoloNetNewsWeb||credits.html|Credits}}</ref> and published on the [[HoloNet News (original website)|HoloNet News website]] on [[May 9]], [[2002]].<ref name="HNN55 date">{{JCFCite|url=posts/6774521|board=Literature|thread=The Official HoloNetNews Discussion Thread|user=IAmTheDarkSide|date=2002-05-09|time=4:55 PM|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20220810173916/https://boards.theforce.net/threads/the-official-holonetnews-discussion-thread.5990764/page-14#post-6774521}}</ref> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' first established that Dasoor was a world and placed it in grid square K-18.<ref name="TEA" />
